name: Alfa Romeo P3
context: Anthony Powys-Lybbe's mount for the 1950 handicap contest.

name: Jaguar XK120
context: Tommy Wisdom's car, in which Moss won the 1950 TT.

name: Alfa Romeo 159
context: Farina's 1951 Ulster Trophy winner, with a 4:44 lap record.

name: Jaguar C-Type
context: Moss's 1951 TT winner; C-Types finished first, second and fourth. A C-Type also won the 1955 handicap Champion Trophy.

name: Ferrari 375
context: The Vandervell-entered car of Taruffi's 1952 Ulster Trophy win.

name: Cooper-Bristol
context: Mike Hawthorn's car, second in the 1952 Ulster Trophy.

name: BRM V16
context: The experimental V16 of Moss and Fangio's notable but unsuccessful 1952 Ulster Trophy appearance.

name: Ferrari 500
context: Hawthorn's winning Formula Two car in the 1953 Ulster Trophy.

name: Aston Martin DB3S
context: Collins and Griffith's 1953 TT winner; a recurring British works entry.

name: Ferrari 750 Monza
context: Hawthorn and Trintignant's 1954 TT scratch-result winner.

name: DB-Panhard
context: The small car of Laureau and Armagnac's 1954 handicap Tourist Trophy classification.

name: Jaguar D-Type
context: Titterington's Ecurie Ecosse mount in the May 1955 Ulster Trophy; the works car he shared with Hawthorn set the 1955 TT lap record at 4:42.

name: Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR
context: Moss and Fitch's 1955 victory and the final Dundrod car TT.

name: Elva
context: Richard Mainwaring's car in the 1955 TT.
